 GTA 6 Features Three Strip Clubs Across Vice City and Leonida
 Nov 19, 2026 • 13:37 
 • 175 Reads 
 Richard Hall 
 Share 
 Font Size 
 A− 
 A 
 A+ 
 Bsinews.id, Jakarta , Vice City 's nightlife offers players several adult entertainment venues in Grand Theft Auto VI , with three confirmed strip clubs spread across the fictional state of Leonida. Coverage published on November 19, 2026, identifies Jack of Hearts, NINE1NINE and Delights Cabaret as the establishments players can visit. According to Beebom and Sportskeeda, these locations provide different entertainment experiences, ranging from traditional cabaret performances to more luxurious nightclub environments.
 Some venues also connect directly to characters and missions within the game's main storyline. Jack of Hearts occupies a central position in Crosstown, Vice City, between Miramar Dr and NE 4th Ave. Sportskeeda identifies Boobie Ike as its owner, while Dre'Quan Priest has an association with the establishment through his music career and Only Raw Records.

 According to DualShockers, the venue becomes part of Jason's storyline when his old friend Dre'Quan invites him to visit. Players also encounter Boobie Ike there, a businessman who becomes involved in Jason and Lucia's living arrangements.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Gameplay Clips Emerge After New Zealand Launch 
 NINE1NINE offers a more upscale alternative. Located south of Crosstown near the Downtown area, the establishment combines nightclub entertainment with traditional strip club facilities, according to Beebom and DualShockers. Private entertainment at NINE1NINE costs $300, according to Beebom. DualShockers describes its VIP experience as considerably more affordable than the equivalent service at Jack of Hearts, where VIP dances cost $1,000.
 Delights Cabaret provides the third confirmed location. Situated in Port Gellhorn, west of the main Vice City area along Interstate 404, the establishment has a more traditional cabaret atmosphere. DualShockers reports that players first encounter Delights Cabaret during Chapter 2, when Vicki introduces them to her boss. Unlike Jack of Hearts, its setting resembles a bar with dancers performing in a separate area.
 Players can also access private dances at these establishments. Beebom explains that approaching a dancer and holding L2 or LT while looking at them allows players to request the service by briefly holding Triangle or Y. The reported standard price is $300, although individual venue pricing differs.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Missions Reveal Different Consequences for Player Choices 
 During private performances, players can provide additional $50 tips. Sportskeeda reports that these payments unlock additional interactions, while Beebom notes that tipping can extend the experience in VIP areas. Rockstar's game also distinguishes between adult entertainment and sexual interactions.
 According to Beebom, strip club visits do not provide sexual intercourse, and the available activities remain limited to private dances and associated interactions.
 Beyond the three confirmed establishments, Vice City contains several other nightlife destinations. DualShockers identifies The Vault and VYB as dance clubs, while Sportskeeda lists Effluvia, Malibu Club, The Rusty Anchor, Bobby Hurricane's and Kington Hotel as additional venues.
 Also Read 
 Rockstar Expands GTA 6 Romance and Criminal Profile Systems 
 Sportskeeda cautions that these additional establishments have not all been confirmed as strip clubs. The Vault may contain a strip club section, but its established role is primarily that of a nightclub featuring multiple rooms, music styles and DJs. VYB, located in the northeastern portion of Ocean Beach, is another restricted nightlife destination. DualShockers reports that access is tied to Dre'Quan's storyline and a main mission in Act 4 rather than unrestricted visits.
